states.yes: Granted as a distinct enforceable right

states.no: Not granted as a distinct right

ukgdpr.note: Also under the Data Protection Act 2018.

fadp.note: Deletion available where processing is unlawful or the data is inaccurate.

appi.note: Erasure or cessation of use on specified grounds.

nzpa.note: No general erasure right; correction is provided instead.

popia.note: Deletion where the party is no longer authorized to hold the data.

ccpa.note: Added by CPRA; absent from the original CCPA.
Delivered through Right to Know, not a standalone portability right.

pipl.note: Transfer where CAC conditions are met.

pipa-kr.note: A transmission right is being phased in under the 2023 amendment.

appi.note: Disclosure can be requested electronically, but no transfer-to-controller right.

dpdp.note: No data portability right in the Act.

rows.label: Right to opt out of sale or sharing

gdpr.note: No sale concept; objection to direct marketing is absolute.

lgpd.note: No direct equivalent; processing rests on legal bases and consent.

pipl.note: Separate consent required for provision to third parties.

ukgdpr.note: No sale concept; objection to direct marketing is absolute.

fadp.note: No sale concept; the person can object to certain processing.

pdpa-ar.note: Right to be removed from direct-marketing databases.

lpdp-uy.note: Right to object in direct-marketing databases.

pipa-kr.note: Consent required before providing data to third parties; no sale opt-out as such.

popia.note: Right to object to processing for direct marketing.

kdpa.note: Right to object to processing for direct marketing.

ccpa.note: Limited; opt-out and Limit-the-Use mechanisms rather than a general objection right.

fadp.note: Processing against the person's express wishes requires justification.

pdpa-ar.note: Objection tied to specific grounds rather than a general right.

lpdp-uy.note: Objection in defined cases rather than a general right.

appi.note: Right to request cessation of use.

nzpa.note: No general right to object to processing.

dpdp.note: No general objection right; withdrawing consent is the main lever.

ccpa.note: Automated decision-making rules developing under CPRA rulemaking.

fadp.note: Information and human review of automated decisions.

pipa-kr.note: Right to refuse or seek explanation of automated decisions, 2023 amendment.

dpdp.note: No specific automated-decision right in the Act.

ccpa.note: Limit the Use of Sensitive Personal Information.

fadp.note: Disputed data can be blocked pending resolution.

pdpa-ar.note: Blocking during a dispute over accuracy.

appi.note: Cessation of use available on specified grounds.

popia.note: Restriction where accuracy is contested or processing is objected to.

kdpa.note: Restriction tied to objection and accuracy disputes.

rows.label: Right to non-discrimination for exercising rights

gdpr.note: Protected in principle, not framed as a standalone right.

lgpd.note: Implied through good-faith and non-discrimination principles.

ukgdpr.note: Protected in principle, not a standalone right.

fadp.note: Protected through good-faith and proportionality principles.

pdpa-ar.note: General good-faith principle rather than a standalone right.

pipa-kr.note: Protected through general principles, not a standalone right.

appi.note: Protected through proper-handling duties, not a standalone right.
